init.description:
**Historical water prices (per m³)**

Enter **one tariff change per line** in the field below using `YYYY-MM-DD;price`.

Example:
```text
2025-01-01;7.92
2026-01-01;8.40
```

Each price applies from its effective date until the next change. Before the first date, the base price is used. Fixed subscription charges are excluded.
